visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Tuple Unpacking Instead of Index Chains
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The loop reaches into result[len(result) - 1] and intervals[i][0] again and again. Unpack each interval and use result[-1]. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Unpacking names the two numbers, result[-1] reads the last item without arithmetic, and max replaces the nested if that only updated the end.
